meta.name: The Crystal Quest
meta.description: Retrieve the Crystal of Power from the forest cave and return it to the wizard.

tavern.name: The Rusty Flagon
tavern.description: A cozy tavern with a crackling fireplace. The bartender polishes glasses behind the bar. A wooden chest sits in the corner.

on_enter.text: The warmth of the fire embraces you. A wizard in the corner catches your eye.

forest_edge.name: Forest Edge
forest_edge.description: Tall trees loom before you. A narrow path winds into the dark woods. You can hear something skittering in the undergrowth.

deep_forest.name: Deep Forest
deep_forest.description: The canopy blocks out most of the light. Thick webs hang between the trees. An iron gate blocks the path further north.

north.on_unlock: The rusty key turns in the lock with a grinding screech. The gate swings open.
north.locked_msg: An iron gate blocks the way. It's locked.

crystal_cave.name: Crystal Cave
crystal_cave.description: The cave glows with an ethereal blue light. In the center, a crystal floats above a stone pedestal.

on_enter.text: The air hums with magical energy. You feel the crystal calling to you.

rusty_sword.name: Rusty Sword
rusty_sword.description: A dull but serviceable blade. Better than nothing.

health_potion.name: Health Potion
health_potion.description: A small vial of glowing red liquid.

rusty_key.name: Rusty Key
rusty_key.description: An old iron key covered in rust. It might fit the gate in the forest.

power_crystal.name: Crystal of Power
power_crystal.description: A brilliant blue crystal that pulses with magical energy.

spider_silk.name: Spider Silk
spider_silk.description: A bundle of incredibly strong silk from the giant spider.

spell_book.name: Spell Book
spell_book.description: A leather-bound tome filled with arcane knowledge.

tavern_chest.name: Wooden Chest
tavern_chest.description: A small wooden chest tucked in the corner.

old_map.name: Faded Map
old_map.description: A map showing the forest paths. There's an X marked at a cave.

on_examine.text: Studying the map carefully, you notice a hidden trail marked with small runes.

lockpick.name: Lockpick
lockpick.description: A thin metal pick for opening locks.

on_failure.message: The pick snaps! You'll need another.

wizard.name: Old Wizard
wizard.description: An elderly wizard in blue robes. His beard nearly touches the floor.

dialogue.greeting: Ah, a brave soul! I've been waiting for someone like you. Ask me about the quest.
dialogue.default: Hmm, I know nothing of that.

quest.text: Deep in the forest lies a Crystal of Power. Retrieve it and bring it to me. Take the key by the forest edge, you'll need it for the gate.

crystal.text: The Crystal of Power is an ancient artifact. It must not fall into the wrong hands.
crystal.locked_text: Ask me about the quest first.

danger.text: Beware the giant spider that guards the forest path. It won't let you pass easily.
danger.locked_text: There's nothing to warn you about yet.

wizard.accept_message: The wizard's eyes widen. 'You found it! The Crystal of Power! As promised, take this spell book. You've earned it, adventurer.'

giant_spider.name: Giant Spider
giant_spider.description: A spider the size of a large dog. Its fangs drip with venom.
giant_spider.aggro_text: The Giant Spider lunges at you!
giant_spider.on_defeat_msg: The spider collapses, its legs curling inward. A bundle of silk falls from its web.
giant_spider.on_flee_msg: You scramble away from the spider's reach!
